title: 1.1 Write `web/src/kit/data/cursor-list.test.ts` first (first assertion on `typeof createCursorList`; the scenarios of "A cursor list loads one page at a time and appends the next" and "A failed page keeps the rows and a stale answer is dropped"; deferred promises per request, `ApiRequestError` from `web/src/api/client.ts`, `KitError` from `web/src/kit/errors.ts`), then implement `DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE` (50), the types and `createCursorList` in `web/src/kit/data/cursor-list.ts`. State is `{ status, items, nextCursor, error }`; `getState()` returns one object until a change; subscribers run in order and a throwing one does not stop the others. `load()` works from `idle` only (cursor `null`), `loadMore()` from `loaded` with `nextCursor !== null` only, `retry()` from `error` only (it repeats the failed request; an `ApiRequestError` with code `CURSOR_INVALID` clears the rows and restarts at the first page); any other call is a no-op that settles with the request in flight (if any); the methods never reject. `reset()` aborts the request in flight, empties the list, goes to `idle`, notifying only on a change. Each request has its own `AbortController`; a generation counter makes the answer or rejection of a request that `reset()` overtook change nothing. A failure keeps the rows. `pageSize` is an integer 1 to 200 (default `DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE`), else `KitError("KIT_PROP_INVALID", ...)`. A page is invalid, and the state is `error` with `ApiRequestError(200, "INVALID_RESPONSE", "Invalid page")`, when `items` is not an array, `next_cursor` is neither `null` nor a string of 1 to 1,024 characters or it equals the cursor just requested, implementing requirements "A cursor list loads one page at a time and appends the next" and "A failed page keeps the rows and a stale answer is dropped"
